title: H3 of the shipped delivery-gate-stop.ps1.roundcap-fixes.diff does not apply to the current live hook, and its underlying approach (last-VERDICT-line-is-operative) is empirically unsound against this repo's own real corpus
evidence: The manifest records sha256 28c1ae4463875bf17be245d85cb5baeb92e0a764ad0ee844a652929d11047337 for D:/ai_os/.claude/hooks/delivery-gate-stop.ps1 both before and after this unit's session, and I independently confirmed that is still the live hook's exact hash right now (sha256sum run directly). So the file has not changed since or during their session. Yet `patch -p0 --fuzz=10 cand.ps1 < qa/evidence/iss-346-round-cap-mechanical-check/delivery-gate-stop.roundcap-fixes.diff` applies hunk 1 (H1+H2, Get-ManifestSeam) cleanly but FAILS hunk 2 (H3, the verdict-reading fix) at every fuzz level -- the live hook does not contain the `if ((Strip-Code ($vt -replace '\*\*', '')) -notmatch ...)` line the diff's old side shows. Instead the live hook already has a considerably more sophisticated `$script:VERDICT_VOCAB` + `Get-VerdictTokens` + `Test-VerdictPass` mechanism (lines ~90-128) with an extensive comment block explicitly explaining why 'the LAST VERDICT line is operative' (exactly H3's proposed rule) is WRONG for this corpus: this repo's verdicts are written both cycles-append-downward (iss-104-closed-class-function-words.md: FAIL at line 12, operative PASS at line 174) AND newest-first-with-archive (vector-cosine-retriever.md: PASS at line 13, ARCHIVED cycle-1 FAIL at line 326) -- 21 verdicts disagree first-vs-last, 17 FAIL->PASS and 4 PASS->FAIL, and 'no line order tells the two apart', so the live hook deliberately counts 'ANY operative-form PASS' rather than 'the last VERDICT line'. I ran H3's own proposed regex (`(?im)^[\s\-*#>|]*VERDICT:?[ \t]*([A-Za-z-]+)`, last match) directly against the real file qa/verdicts/vector-cosine-retriever.md: it returned the token 'RULE', not PASS or FAIL -- because H3's capture group has no vocabulary restriction (unlike the live hook's VERDICT_VOCAB) and matches arbitrary prose words following the literal string 'verdict'. So H3 as shipped is not merely inapplicable text-wise; applied by hand to today's live hook it would (a) frequently return garbage tokens on real files and (b) misread the documented newest-first-archive case in exactly the direction the live hook's own comments warn against. Assertion 4b in the shipped standing test (qa/tests/mc-hooks-round-cap.ps1) only exercises a synthetic two-file PASS-then-FAIL shape and does not include a vocabulary-noise or newest-first-archive fixture, so it does not catch either problem.
fix_direction: Drop H3 from the diff (H1 and H2 are real, apply cleanly to the live hook as verified, and independently falsify/restore correctly) or rebuild it against the live hook's actual Get-VerdictTokens/Test-VerdictPass/VERDICT_VOCAB implementation rather than the simpler single-regex shape the current diff assumes. Any replacement must be measured against qa/verdicts/vector-cosine-retriever.md (or an equivalent newest-first-archive fixture) in addition to the iss-104 append-downward fixture already in the suite, and the 'Blocked / disclosed' section's Approver instructions ('git apply ... expect RESULT: PASS (11/11 assertions)') need correcting -- the assertion count is also inconsistently stated as 11/11 there vs 12/12 elsewhere in the same manifest.
reproductions: patch -p0 --fuzz=10 cand.ps1 < qa/evidence/iss-346-round-cap-mechanical-check/delivery-gate-stop.roundcap-fixes.diff  -- hunk 1 succeeds (fuzz 1), hunk 2 FAILS at every fuzz level against a fresh copy of the live hook (sha256 28c1ae44... matches the manifest's own recorded before/after hash)

PowerShell one-liner running H3's exact proposed regex against qa/verdicts/vector-cosine-retriever.md's real content returns token 'RULE', not a VERDICT_VOCAB member -- see checker verdict for the exact command
notes: This does not impeach the standing test qa/tests/mc-hooks-round-cap.ps1 itself, which I independently verified reproduces the manifest's claimed 9/12 baseline exactly, correctly reddens (does not stay green) when the D-014 security-class exemption is inverted to count-based, and whose D-015 ISS-346 reproductions 1-3 all replay verbatim. The defect is scoped to the H3 hunk of the packaged fix-diff and the Approver-facing claim that it is ready to land.
fixed_evidence: checker(iss-346-round-cap-mechanical-check, cycle 1): H3 dropped entirely from the shipped diff, not rebuilt -- the live hook's own $script:VERDICT_VOCAB / Get-VerdictTokens / Test-VerdictPass mechanism (cumulative: any operative-form PASS anywhere in the file counts, order-independent) already solves the newest-first-archive problem H3 could not, confirmed by reading the hook's own comment block (lines ~109-121) which documents the corpus evidence (21 verdicts disagree first-vs-last) for exactly this design. Independently re-ran H3's own proposed regex against the real qa/verdicts/vector-cosine-retriever.md and reproduced the checker's original 'RULE' finding verbatim, confirming H3 is still unsound and correctly abandoned rather than patched. New assertions 11 (real hook finds the true PASS on a fixture modeled on that file) and 12 (H3's exact regex misreads the same fixture as 'RULE') both independently re-run and confirmed PASS. Standing test 13/14 against the current live hook (sha256 5d6e09943119b4f26b13c93dd32d8e28bd11099447b13c4d32ded074a51ec162, 823 lines; only the unrelated comma-list gap red) and 14/14 against the packaged one-hunk candidate (sha256 fe02a112563effd5df66711f2e468191b4bf9597bb5fc08191b56a7fafdca17b), both independently reproduced. See qa/verdicts/iss-346-round-cap-mechanical-check.md cycle 1 for full detail.
